_comment: Catalog of Novator apps. One entry per app or freemium pair. 'guide' is true once docs/<slug>/ is written. tools/sync_app.py fills icons, screenshots, versions and changelogs from the modules.

apps.title: WooCommerce Connector
apps.summary: Orders, customers, products, stock, prices, refunds and tracking in sync between WooCommerce and Odoo.

apps.title: Shopify Connector
apps.summary: Orders, products, stock per location, prices, Markets, refunds, fulfillments and Shopify Payments payouts in sync between Shopify and Odoo.

apps.title: Amazon Connector
apps.summary: FBM and FBA orders with VAT, listings, stock and prices, shipment confirmation, FBA stock and returns, refunds and settlements between Amazon and Odoo.

apps.title: Jazi Connector
apps.summary: List products on Jazi in English and Arabic, send stock and prices, and turn Jazi orders into sales orders with fulfilment and AWB from Odoo.

apps.title: Dashboard Builder
apps.summary: KPI tiles, 13 chart types and lists from any Odoo data. Pro: AI, drill-down, TV mode, SQL, email digests.

apps.title: Access Manager
apps.summary: Hide menus, read-only users, no developer mode. Pro: fields, buttons, records, chatter and filter rules.

apps.title: AI Connector for Claude & MCP
apps.summary: Connect Claude and other AI apps to Odoo with each user's own access rights. Pro: approvals, undo, limits.

apps.title: Direct Print
apps.summary: Print reports, labels and receipts straight to local and network printers, no dialogs.

apps.title: Barcode Label Designer
apps.summary: Design ZPL and PDF labels inside Odoo: fields, barcodes, QR codes, line tables and nested labels for any model; work order labels in the Enterprise edition.

apps.title: Storage Manager
apps.summary: Analyse database storage and move old attachments to Google Drive, S3 or Cloudflare R2.

apps.title: Device Access Control
apps.summary: Allow sign-in only from approved devices, with Login Audit as the free companion.

apps.title: POS Counter Ticket
apps.summary: Counter tickets and pickup numbers for bakeries and food counters in Point of Sale.

apps.title: Price Checker Kiosk
apps.summary: A self-service price checker for shop customers: scan a barcode, see price and stock.

apps.title: Daily Stock Ledger
apps.summary: Opening, in, out and closing stock per product per day.

apps.title: POS Scale Integration
apps.summary: Connect a weighing scale to Odoo Point of Sale through the browser, no IoT box.

apps.title: Bank Alfalah Payments
apps.summary: Accept card payments in Odoo through Bank Alfalah.

apps.title: Fatora Payments
apps.summary: Accept payments in Odoo through Fatora.
